what: Same launch (clock +50 days): walk 1,0 → 0,0, leave Play (the land writes the day's visit), then quit: main must not write a second one

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world.value; return JSON.stringify({ screen: S.useSessionStore.getState().screen, head: w.now.head.n, pending: w.status.pending, visits: Object.values(w.now.events).filter(e => e.kind === 'visit').map(e => ({ n: e.n, chunks: e.body.chunks })) }) })()
